const page = await browser.getPage("main");
await page.getByRole("button", { name: /Fetch table & run pipeline/ }).click();
console.log("clicked fetch");
let ok = false;
for (let i = 0; i < 30; i++) {
  await page.waitForTimeout(5000);
  const st = await page.evaluate(() => {
    const mb = document.getElementById("mapBadge");
    const fi = document.getElementById("fileInfo") || document.querySelector("[id*=fileInfo]");
    return {
      mapBadge: mb ? mb.innerText.trim() : null,
      fileInfo: fi ? fi.innerText.trim() : null,
      qitems: document.querySelectorAll(".qitem").length,
      bodyHas: document.body.innerText.includes("flagged")
    };
  });
  console.log(i, JSON.stringify(st));
  if (st.qitems > 0) { ok = true; break; }
}
console.log(ok ? "PIPELINE DONE" : "PIPELINE NOT DONE");

verify-cqn-mapping-and-rowcount

2 actions · 170ms
Script
const page = await browser.getPage("main");
const st = await page.evaluate(() => {
  const mb = document.getElementById("mapBadge");
  const txt = document.body.innerText;
  const rowLine = txt.split("\n").filter(l => /row|record|Loaded|queues|flagged/i.test(l)).slice(0, 12);
  const items = [...document.querySelectorAll(".qitem")];
  const unmapped = [...document.querySelectorAll(".qitem")].filter(q => /unmapped/i.test(q.innerText)).length;
  const allUnmapped = [...document.querySelectorAll("*")].filter(e => e.children.length===0 && e.textContent.trim().toLowerCase()==="unmapped").length;
  return {
    mapBadgeRaw: mb ? mb.innerText : null,
    mapBadgeText: mb ? mb.textContent.trim().replace(/\s+/g," ") : null,
    rowLines: rowLine,
    qitemCount: items.length,
    unmappedInCards: unmapped,
    unmappedBadgesAnywhere: allUnmapped,
    firstThree: items.slice(0,3).map(q => q.innerText.replace(/\n/g," | "))
  };
});
console.log(JSON.stringify(st, null, 2));

locate-stray-unmapped-badge

2 actions · 177ms
Script
const page = await browser.getPage("main");
const st = await page.evaluate(() => {
  const hits = [...document.querySelectorAll("*")].filter(e => e.children.length===0 && e.textContent.trim().toLowerCase()==="unmapped");
  return hits.map(h => ({
    tag: h.tagName, cls: h.className, id: h.id,
    parentCls: h.parentElement ? h.parentElement.className : null,
    visible: !!(h.offsetParent || h.getClientRects().length),
    ancestorIds: (function(){let a=h,o=[];while(a){if(a.id)o.push(a.id);a=a.parentElement;}return o;})()
  }));
});
console.log(JSON.stringify(st, null, 2));

    paneIds: panes.map(p=>p.id),

  };
});

const page = await browser.getPage("main");
const st = await page.evaluate(() => {
  const sels = [...document.querySelectorAll("select")];
  const invBtns = [...document.querySelectorAll("button")].filter(b=>/investigat/i.test(b.innerText));
  const sel = document.querySelector(".qitem.sel, .qitem.active, .qitem[aria-selected=true]");
  // find the investigation panel: nearest container with the investigate button
  const panel = invBtns[0] ? invBtns[0].closest("div[id], section") : null;
  return {
    selectedCard: sel ? sel.innerText.replace(/\n/g," | ") : null,
    selects: sels.map(s=>({id:s.id, name:s.name, value:s.value, selText:s.selectedOptions[0]?s.selectedOptions[0].text:null, opts:[...s.options].map(o=>o.text)})),
    investigateButtons: invBtns.map(b=>({txt:b.innerText.trim(), id:b.id})),
    panelId: panel ? panel.id : null,
    panelHead: panel ? panel.innerText.slice(0,700) : null
  };
});
console.log(JSON.stringify(st, null, 2));

Script
const page = await browser.getPage("main");
const st = await page.evaluate(() => {
  const p = document.getElementById("investigationPanel");
  const modelSel = p ? p.querySelector("select") : null;
  const sel = document.querySelector(".qitem.sel, .qitem.active, .qitem.on, .qitem[aria-selected=true]");
  const cards = [...document.querySelectorAll(".qitem")];
  const selIdx = cards.findIndex(c => /sel|active|on\b/.test(c.className));
  // header area of detail
  const head = document.getElementById("qHead") || document.getElementById("rcaHead");
  return {
    selectedCardClass: sel ? sel.className : null,
    selectedCardText: sel ? sel.innerText.replace(/\n/g," | ") : null,
    modelSelectId: modelSel ? (modelSel.id || "(no id)") : null,
    modelSelectValue: modelSel ? modelSel.value : null,
    modelSelectedText: modelSel && modelSel.selectedOptions[0] ? modelSel.selectedOptions[0].text : null,
    modelOptions: modelSel ? [...modelSel.options].map(o=>({v:o.value,t:o.text})) : null,
    modelOnchange: modelSel ? String(modelSel.getAttribute("onchange")) : null,
    rcaCurrent: window._rcaCurrent ? JSON.stringify(window._rcaCurrent).slice(0,300) : null,
    detailHeadIds: [...document.querySelectorAll("[id]")].map(e=>e.id).filter(i=>/rca|detail|invest|head/i.test(i))
  };
});
console.log(JSON.stringify(st, null, 2));

investigate-a-llama-groq

9 actions · 6.0s
Script
const page = await browser.getPage("main");
// mapped badge check before investigating
const pre = await page.evaluate(() => {
  const hits=[...document.querySelectorAll("span.badge")].filter(b=>/^mapped$/i.test(b.textContent.trim()));
  return { mappedBadges: hits.map(h=>({cls:h.className, visible: !!(h.offsetParent), ctx:(h.parentElement.innerText||"").replace(/\n/g," | ").slice(0,160)})) };
});
console.log("PRE-MAPPED:", JSON.stringify(pre, null, 2));

const sel = page.locator("#investigationPanel select.rca-model-sel").first();
await sel.selectOption({ label: "Llama 3.3 70B (Groq) — fast baseline" });
await page.waitForTimeout(500);
console.log("MODEL NOW:", await page.evaluate(()=> window.RCA_MODEL ? JSON.stringify(window.RCA_MODEL) : null));
console.log("_rcaCurrent after model change:", await page.evaluate(()=>String(window._rcaCurrent)));

await page.getByRole("button", { name: /Investigate Root Cause/ }).click();
console.log("clicked investigate");
let done=false;
for (let i=0;i<30;i++){
  await page.waitForTimeout(5000);
  const s = await page.evaluate(()=>{
    const b=document.getElementById("invBody");
    const t=b?b.innerText:"";
    return { len:t.length, hasEngine:/Engine:/.test(t), tail:t.slice(-200).replace(/\n/g," / ") };
  });
  console.log(i, JSON.stringify(s));
  if (s.hasEngine){done=true;break;}
}
console.log(done?"INV-A RENDERED":"INV-A TIMEOUT");

investigate-d-deepseek-v4-flash

38 actions · 1m 26s
Script
const page = await browser.getPage("main");
const sel = page.locator("#invBody select.rca-model-sel").first();
await sel.selectOption({ label: "DeepSeek V4 Flash — reasoning" });
console.log("MODEL NOW:", await page.evaluate(()=> JSON.stringify(window.RCA_MODEL)));
let done=false;
for (let i=0;i<30;i++){
  await page.waitForTimeout(5000);
  const s = await page.evaluate(()=>{
    const b=document.getElementById("invBody"); const t=b?b.innerText:"";
    const m=t.match(/Engine:[^\n]*/);
    return { len:t.length, engine:m?m[0]:null, head:(t.match(/^.*Fiscal Week \d+/m)||[])[0]||null };
  });
  if (s.engine){ console.log(i, JSON.stringify(s)); done=true; break; }
  if (i%3===0) console.log(i, "waiting len="+s.len);
}
if(!done) console.log("INV-D TIMEOUT");
const t = await page.evaluate(()=> document.getElementById("invBody").innerText);
const pick = (re)=>{const m=t.match(re);return m?m[0]:"n/a";};
console.log("HEAD:", pick(/^.*Fiscal Week \d+/m));
console.log("CAUSE:", t.split("\n")[8]);
console.log("CONF-BLOCK:", (t.match(/CONFIDENCE\n[\s\S]{0,40}/)||["n/a"])[0].replace(/\n/g," "));
console.log("MISSING:", (t.match(/MISSING INFORMATION\n[\s\S]*?\nEngine:/)||["n/a"])[0].replace(/\n/g," | "));
console.log("ENGINE:", pick(/Engine:[^\n]*/));

assert-multimodel-and-cqn-mapping

4 actions · 1.5s
Script
const page = await browser.getPage("main");
await page.evaluate(()=>{
  const e=[...document.querySelectorAll("#invBody *")].find(x=>x.children.length===0&&/^Engine:/.test(x.textContent.trim()));
  if(e) e.scrollIntoView({block:"center"});
});
await page.waitForTimeout(1200);
const r = await page.evaluate(()=>{
  const t=document.getElementById("invBody").innerText;
  const mb=document.getElementById("mapBadge");
  const unmVisible=[...document.querySelectorAll("span.badge")].filter(b=>/^unmapped$/i.test(b.textContent.trim())&&b.offsetParent).length;
  const mappedOk=[...document.querySelectorAll("span.badge.ok")].filter(b=>/^mapped$/i.test(b.textContent.trim())&&b.offsetParent).length;
  return {
    mapBadge: mb?mb.textContent.trim().replace(/\s+/g," "):null,
    unmVisible, mappedOk,
    engine:(t.match(/Engine:[^\n]*/)||[])[0]||null,
    head:(t.match(/^.*Fiscal Week \d+/m)||[])[0]||null,
    cause:(t.match(/Fiscal Week \d+\n([^\n]+)/)||[])[1]||null,
    rows: (document.body.innerText.match(/66,612 rows/)||[])[0]||null
  };
});
const chk=(n,c,d)=>console.log((c?"PASS":"FAIL")+" — "+n+(d?" — "+d:""));
console.log(JSON.stringify(r,null,2));
chk("page loaded", true);
chk("SQL fetch + pipeline", r.rows==="66,612 rows", r.rows);
chk("mapBadge text", r.mapBadge==="CQN mapped from SQL · 442 queues 69 multi-queue", r.mapBadge);
chk("zero visible unmapped badges", r.unmVisible===0, "count="+r.unmVisible);
chk("queue header green mapped badge", r.mappedOk>=1, "count="+r.mappedOk);
chk("queue identity stable across model switches", r.head==="NA Core Spanish · Fiscal Week 202719", r.head);
chk("Engine footer is llm for final model", /^Engine: llm/.test(r.engine||""), r.engine);
chk("cause type", r.cause==="Genuine demand event", r.cause);
